title: sonic-playground playlist (data/backlog/<file>.toml)
description: A playlist of the owner's as data: its items in order, each a recording. It holds relationships, never review metadata: scripts/catalog.py resolves every item to one review (by ISRC, then by artist and song, unless review= or skip= says otherwise) and derives from kind = "yearbook" the yearbook pages, counts and each song's years. scripts/spotify.py writes these files; a transcription may be written by hand. No account identifier is ever stored.

kind.description: yearbook: the owner's annual Top Songs of `year`.

year.description: The listening year a yearbook covers (not a release year).

name.description: The playlist's name as the source shows it.

source.description: Where the items come from (API, data export, transcription) and when.

expected.description: How many items the source says the playlist has; the import reports retrieved against it.

title.description: The recording title as the source gives it.

spotify.description: Spotify track id (a public catalogue id).

uncertain.description: The item could not be read completely; it is never resolved by guess.

review.description: Identity override: this item is that review.

skip.description: Why this item gets no review (not a song, unavailable, ...).
